name: Prisma
subtitle: TypeScript ORM
creator: Prisma (formerly Graphcool, founded 2016)
description: An ORM for Node.js and TypeScript: you describe your data in a schema file, and Prisma generates a fully typed client plus migrations. Version 7 removed the Rust engine for smaller, faster deploys.
useCases: Teams that want autocomplete for queries

codeSamples.label: Prisma schema + TypeScript

cons: Complex queries may need raw SQL

pricing.summary: ORM is free and open source. Prisma Postgres (managed database) has free and paid plans.
